Results.ReviewText: I stepped into my Local ACE Hardware store here in Texas and the store manager said hey did you know we were having a Labor Day sale on our Grills?  I said no I just need trimmer line. He then began the pitch, after about 10 minutes he had me over in the grill display area and I was kind of impressed with the prices I must admit. This was definitely a real deal for these grills, he had 3-4 different brands. Of course I was and am partial to Weber. He asked me a few very pertinent questions and said check em out I'll be right back. In about 5 minutes I had looked at most everything and had come to the conclusion it would be a good thing with these prices to really consider a new one. When the manager returned he handed me a flyer that had 10%off on any grill in the store. It was a national coupon so it wasn't the main discount, it was on top of what the store had already marked off. I did a couple of calculations and then it hit me, I wonder what the online website has these priced at?  So without him watching I pulled up the Weber site and amazingly enough one of the models that was right in front of me was on sale as well on the website and it was better than his price. I told him what I had found, and he said hang on let me see if we price match. He came back and said we will match that price but we can't do the coupon, I said well how about my military discount I always get, he said well that's a different story. Let me go make a call. In a couple of minutes he was back and said we really have to honor the military at 10% off as well, I got my Spirit E-210 Weber Grill for 195.00 off and they delivered it. I told 5-6 people of this super fantastic offer and 2 of them bought that weekend. My old grill was donated and life is good. I really wanted a new Genisis but I was happy with the one I managed to secure at that great price. The Genisis will have to wait for a little while longer. Weber grills are tried and true I sold them at Sears back in the day. Sold more Weber than any other grill even more than the Craftsmans.  I highly recommend the new models.  Weber has made so many nice upgrades and they stand behind their products.
Results.Title: My 3rd Weber grill in 10 years

Open the door to the world of grilling with crazy good food and friends coming together. Equipped with the powerful GS4 grilling system, this two burner gas grill is your entry to the Weber family and to everyday grilling. The compact open-cart design and the practical folding side table makes it fit even on small spaces, and you have all the basics you need to get familiar with gas grilling. So whether it’s a busy Monday or a relaxed Sunday – invite a couple of friends over, push the ignition and enjoy the special atmosphere that surrounds the grill.


 This product requires assembly.
